title: Overview of the HASOC track at FIRE 2020: Hate Speech and Offensive Content Identification in Indo-European Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigating lexical and topical bias in dataset creation by avoiding traditional keyword-based scraping. Instead, the authors use a weak SVM classifier to randomly sample potentially hateful tweets from a general Twitter archive to ensure a more balanced and representative dataset.

Reducing subjective human bias during the data labeling process by assigning multiple independent native-speaking annotators to each tweet and using a reliability-weighted voting algorithm or a third tie-breaking annotator to resolve conflicts.
